method: web tool open/click/find; official Cloudflare Container/Worker documentation only

sources.title: Limits and Instance Types
sources.finding: The documented basic type has 1 GiB memory and one quarter vCPU. This motivates the local comparison profile; equivalence of enforcement is unproven. Custom types have other constraints and do not make arbitrary small local cgroup profiles deployable.
sources.doesNotEstablish: A delegated cgroup, task/FD/socket ceiling, no-dump policy or this harness's enforcement

sources.title: Durable Object Container API
sources.finding: The direct API separates start, readiness, monitoring and stop; a running container need not be ready. getTcpPort supports HTTP/TCP communication. Monitor must be reattached after a Durable Object restart. The inspected API does not document the full proposed local OS controls.
sources.doesNotEstablish: Shutdown timing, OOM attribution, output retention, cgroup delegation or application compatibility

sources.title: Workers Request
sources.finding: Request exposes a body stream. Runtime body source determines Content-Length and transfer framing. The inspected interface has no documented trailer-observation API; this does not prove a deployed trailer discard/reject outcome.
sources.doesNotEstablish: Original wire header occurrence/framing preservation or a public trailer-reject capability

sources.title: Handle outbound traffic
sources.finding: HTTP interception and Internet-disable policy differ from native arbitrary TCP egress. An HTTP destination allowlist alone does not qualify the plan's direct Neon PostgreSQL TLS and notification path.
sources.doesNotEstablish: Neon TCP reachability, database credentials, notifier recovery or Stripe reconciliation

sources.title: Local Development
sources.finding: Local container development requires a compatible Docker CLI and engine and can build or pull images. This proposal does neither. Documented local/deployed differences reinforce that a local container is not deployed evidence.
sources.doesNotEstablish: An active local engine, installed qualifying Wrangler version or deployed isolation parity

limitations: Documentation facts only. No provider API/account, credentials, deployment, staging event, TLS endpoint, container, Neon or Stripe request was used. API absence is not proof of unsupported provider internals. Public admission remains forbidden pending root selection and separate qualification.
